text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGER triggered — PagerDuty INC-4221 fired for channel=incidents. Condition: inference-gateway eu-west1 5xx rate > 5% (2m). Link: https://graf.redwood/inference/gateway/eu-west1?alert=INC-4221

oncall-sre: acked PD INC-4221. I’m oncall and looking into it now.

maria: @oncall-sre are there any recent deploys to gateway or cache changes? I see a canary for prefix-cache warmup ~6m ago.

oncall-sre: yep canary rolled at 03:12Z to 50%. spike correlates with that window. starting rollback to 0% now.

kevin: quick metrics snapshot — 5xx rate jumped from ~0.3% to 11.7% in eu-west1, p95 latency +220ms. CPU on gateway pods spiked, but GPU pool seems healthy. Suspect KV/prefix cache cold starts amplifying backend load.

kevin: sample gateway error log: 
```
[03:18:42] inference-gateway[euwest1-3]: upstream error: 502 Bad Gateway (connect failed) model=redwood-opt-13b request_id=abc123 retry=2
[03:18:43] inference-gateway[euwest1-4]: connection reset by peer while streaming kvsync ts=161234
```

alex: checked dedicated GPU pool — all nodes green. KV cache miss rate jumped x40 at the same time, lots of concurrent cache-pop requests. Looks like the canary enabled aggressive cache-warm that caused a thundering herd.

eng-runtime: recommend two immediate mitigations: 1) rollback the warmup flag (if not already), 2) enable routing fallback to a steady model variant to shed load from cold-KV path. Also we should turn on rate-limit-by-customer for heavy clients temporarily.

oncall-sre: rollback finished at 03:21:05Z — canary at 0%. Running routing fallback now: 
```
$ rctl routes set inference-gateway eu-west1 --fallback=variant-b --reason "mitigate 5xx spike"
OK: routes updated (applied=eu-west1)
```

maria: thanks. monitoring panels show 5xx dropping back toward baseline over the last 3m. p95 still elevated but trending down.

customer-success: seeing tickets from 3 large customers (ACME, NovaApps, TinyChat) reporting failures in webhook processors. We're opening escalation tickets and notifying account owners. CS will send a status note in ~15m.

kevin: additional logs show upstreams returning ECONNRESET/502 while KV-sync goroutines timeout. Evidence points to cache-warm concurrency limit missing in new code path.

oncall-sre: created incident checklist entry and added eng-runtime as responders. Adding postmortem owner tag.

eng-runtime: we're patching a quick fix to add a concurrency limiter around cache warmers and to exponential-backoff initial warms. Deploy target in 30-45m to canary with zero-ramp on prod until validated.

oncall-sre: handoff: I need to step away for ~40m. @alex — please take first-view and keep paging escalations if 5xx > 2% sustained for 5m. Summary: PagerDuty INC-4221, cause suspected cache warmup thundering herd triggered by recent canary, rollback applied, routing fallback enabled, CS notified.

alex: ack, taking over. I'll keep probes running and will post a short update every 10m. Probe command: 
```
curl -sS -D - https://inference.eu-west1.redwood/api/v1/health -H "x-test-probe: true" | head -n 10
```

oncall-sre: thanks — tagging transition in PD and adding follow-up action items for postmortem: change rollout default to staggered warms, add concurrency limiter, add synthetic probes for KV cold-start.

sre-bot: PD INC-4221 status: acknowledged by oncall-sre. Escalation: eng-runtime added. Notes updated.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: incident state updated in channel. If anything regresses, page again.
